findings.where: All running text is justified: the intro paragraph, the Surf, Vibe and What to look for paragraphs, and the coming-soon announcement. This happens at both widths and is worst on the phone, in the announcement ('MantaHostels   is   launching   across') and the intro ('workers   and   long-stay').
findings.fault: Justified text in a narrow column stretches the spaces between words unevenly. On the phone this leaves wide gaps and channels of white running down the lines, so the text reads unevenly. The house type is left-aligned, and this page sets it otherwise.
findings.who_objects: The phone-first backpacker, often reading in transit. The uneven gaps slow them down and make the guide feel careless. A brand that wants things to feel effortless shouldn't make people work to read a destination guide.

findings.fault: This heading is set unlike its sibling headings, Surf and Good for. It is italic, turquoise and underlined, while they are plain ink Quicksand. The underline and colour make it look like a link, but it does nothing. Turquoise is also a fill colour being used as type.
findings.who_objects: A visitor who taps 'Vibe' expecting a link gets nothing. Anyone scanning the section headings sees one that looks like it belongs to a different system, which makes the page look broken rather than designed.

findings.where: The 'What to look for' section heading, set beside the Surf, Vibe and Good for headings
findings.fault: This heading is a small, widely spaced all-caps label, while the other section headings on the page are large Quicksand in sentence case. Like headings are not set alike, and the rules keep uppercase for badges and filter labels. Here the section that answers the page's second question, what to look for in a hostel, looks the least like a heading.
findings.who_objects: A backpacker scanning the guide for the practical hostel advice may skip past it, because it reads as a caption rather than a section of equal rank to Surf.

findings.where: The page title, 'Best Hostels in Canggu'
findings.fault: The title is in title case, but the brand voice is sentence case throughout ('Best hostels in Canggu').
findings.who_objects: The founder, because the brand's casing rule is broken on the page's most visible line. Destination pages set this way would drift from the rest of the site.
